said.text: My bill places a temporary pause on the sale of AI chatbot toys for small children so experts can study the impact on kids and create smart protections before more damage is done. It’s logical, it’s fair, and most importantly, it makes clear that our children’s safety is nothing for Big Tech to play around with.

did.text: Voted Yes on S9408-A, a five-year moratorium on the sale of AI chatbot toys for small children. Passed Senate 57–3.

whyNote: The statement, issued the day after the vote, describes the same bill the vote passed. Sen. Gounardes is the bill's sponsor and voted yes.
